title: Higher-dimensional operators and Polyakov loop in hot Scalar QED from the heat kernel
summary: Using the finite-temperature heat kernel method, we compute the gauge-invariant effective Lagrangian up to dimension-six for massive hot scalar QED. We propose two complementary methods: integrating out heavy modes at finite temperature, and deriving the finite-temperature heat kernel coefficients from the zero-temperature ones. We show that in the static limit, both lead to the same three-dimensional effective operators.
